Population increased in East Riding of Yorkshire

The estimated population of East Riding of Yorkshire in 2024 was 355,884 usual residents, a rise of 1.3% since 2023.

This meant that East Riding of Yorkshire's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of East Riding of Yorkshire increased by 3.7%.

Over this slightly longer period, East Riding of Yorkshire was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of East Riding of Yorkshire

The average (median) age stayed at 49.6 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of East Riding of Yorkshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
East Riding of Yorkshire is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, East Riding of Yorkshire's population of 355,884 usual residents was made up of:

  • 55,350 people aged 0 to 15 years, (15.6%)
  • 204,130 people aged 16 to 64 years, (57.4%)
  • 96,404 people aged 65 years and over, (27.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, East Riding of Yorkshire has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (27.1% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In East Riding of Yorkshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in East Riding of Yorkshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for East Riding of Yorkshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 1,808 people (-0.5%). In total, there were 2,594 births and 4,402 deaths in East Riding of Yorkshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 5,938 (1.7%). There were 19,753 people entering the area and 13,815 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in East Riding of Yorkshire's population of 548 (0.2%) as a result of 1,265 people entering the area and 717 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for East Riding of Yorkshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of East Riding of Yorkshire in mid-2023 is 351,237.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 93 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 1,025 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,118 people.
